4 /-! The complete wedge step in the original junction coordinates.
5 The circular gap order supplies the arm rotation. The remaining numerical
6 premise is the outer-angle budget, which the global proof must establish.
7 -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
10 
11 open Real Set EuclideanGeometry
12 
13 /-- The two radial triangles over one bisecting cut ray, in the junction plane. -/
14 def gapKite (z : Plane) (d L γ δ : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
15   convexHull ℝ ({z, z + L • direction ((γ + δ) / 2), z + d • direction δ} : Set Plane) ∪
16   convexHull ℝ ({z + L • direction ((γ + δ) / 2), z, z + d • direction γ} : Set Plane)
17 
18 private theorem rooted_polar_image (z c : Plane) (turn : Plane ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Plane)
19     (frame : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane) (formula : ∀ x, frame x = turn (x - z) + c)
20     (τ : ℝ) (directions : ∀ φ, turn (direction φ) = direction (φ - τ))
21     (d ω lower upper : ℝ) :
22     frame '' {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω lower upper} =
23       {x | x - c ∈ polarRegion d ω (lower - τ) (upper - τ)} := by
24   rw [translated_region_image z c turn frame formula]
25   have shifted := polarRegion_image_rotation turn (-τ)
26     (fun φ => by simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using directions φ) d ω lower upper
27   simpa only [← sub_eq_add_neg] using congrArg (fun S : Set Plane => {x | x - c ∈ S}) shifted
28 
29 /-- Expanding around an outgoing kite gives containment, nonoverlap before
30 addition, and an exact updated wedge at the next tree vertex. -/
31 theorem gap_rotate_and_move_with_sources (z : Plane) {d L α β γ δ ω : ℝ}
32     (source_positive : 0 < d) (length_positive : 0 < L)
33     (gap_ordered : γ < δ) (gap_width : δ < γ + 2 * π)
34     (separated : (β ≤ γ ∧ δ ≤ α + 2 * π) ∨ (δ ≤ α ∧ β ≤ γ + 2 * π))
35     (outer_lower : π / 2 ≤ ω)
36     (budget : ω + angle z (z + d • direction δ) (z + L • direction ((γ + δ) / 2)) ≤ 3 * π / 2) :
37     let y := z + L • direction ((γ + δ) / 2)
38     let apex := angle z (z + d • direction δ) y
39     let W := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω α β}
40     let V := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * π)}
41     ∃ D Θ : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ 0 < Θ ∧ Θ < π ∧
42       z + d • direction δ = y + D • direction (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) ∧
43       z + d • direction γ = y + D • direction (2 * π - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) ∧
44       let W' := {x | x - y ∈ polarRegion D (ω + apex)
45         (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) (2 * π - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)}
46       W ⊆ V ∧ Disjoint V (interior (gapKite z d L γ δ)) ∧ W' = V ∪ gapKite z d L γ δ := by
47   dsimp only
48   let θ := (δ - γ) / 2
49   let h := d * sin θ
50   let r := -d * cos θ
51   let y := z + L • direction ((γ + δ) / 2)
52   let apex := angle z (z + d • direction δ) y
53   have outer_upper : ω ≤ 3 * π / 2 := by
54     linarith [angle_nonneg z (z + d • direction δ) y]
55   obtain ⟨turn, directions, lower, upper, lower_moves, upper_moves, rotated⟩ :=
56     rotate_from_disjoint_gap d ω α β γ δ separated
57   obtain ⟨height_positive, _, _, frame, formula, at_root, at_lower, at_upper, on_ray⟩ :=
58     gap_frame z source_positive gap_ordered gap_width turn directions
59   have C := gap_arm_coordinates source_positive gap_ordered gap_width outer_lower outer_upper
60   change ArmCoordinates h r _ _ d θ ω at C
61   obtain ⟨D, Θ, N⟩ := exists_arm_coordinates (r := r + L) height_positive outer_lower outer_upper
62   have angle_eq : angle (point r 0) (point 0 h) (point (r + L) 0) = apex := by
63     have preserved := frame.toAffineIsometry.angle_map z (z + d • direction δ) y
64     change angle (frame z) (frame (z + d • direction δ)) (frame y) = apex at preserved
65     rw [at_root, at_upper, on_ray L] at preserved
66     exact preserved
67   have step := C.rotate_and_move (q := r + L) (by linarith) N.radius_pos N.angle_pos N.angle_lt_pi
68     N.source_x N.source_y lower_moves upper_moves (by rw [angle_eq]; exact budget)
69   dsimp only at step
70   rw [angle_eq] at step
71   have old_image : frame '' {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω α β} =
72       {x | x - point r 0 ∈ polarRegion d ω lower upper} := by
73     rw [translated_region_image z (point r 0) turn frame formula, rotated]
74   have before_image : frame '' {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * π)} =
75       {x | x - point r 0 ∈ polarRegion d ω θ (2 * π - θ)} := by
76     rw [rooted_polar_image z (point r 0) turn frame formula ((γ + δ) / 2) directions]
77     rw [show δ - (γ + δ) / 2 = θ by dsimp [θ]; ring,
78       show γ + 2 * π - (γ + δ) / 2 = 2 * π - θ by dsimp [θ]; ring]
79   have next_formula (x : Plane) : frame x = turn (x - y) + point (r + L) 0 := by
80     calc
81       frame x = turn (x - z) + point r 0 := formula x
82       _ = turn ((x - y) + (y - z)) + point r 0 := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
83       _ = turn (x - y) + (turn (y - z) + point r 0) := by rw [map_add, add_assoc]
84       _ = turn (x - y) + frame y := by rw [formula y]
85       _ = turn (x - y) + point (r + L) 0 := by rw [on_ray L]
86   have after_image : frame '' {x | x - y ∈ polarRegion D (ω + apex)
87         (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) (2 * π - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)} =
88       {x | x - point (r + L) 0 ∈ polarRegion D (ω + apex) Θ (2 * π - Θ)} := by
89     rw [rooted_polar_image y (point (r + L) 0) turn frame next_formula ((γ + δ) / 2) directions,
90       add_sub_cancel_right, add_sub_cancel_right]
91   have kite_image : frame '' gapKite z d L γ δ = kite h r (r + L) := by
92     rw [gapKite, image_union, kite_eq_triangles height_positive (by linarith : r < r + L)]
93     have triangle (x y z : Plane) : frame '' convexHull ℝ ({x, y, z} : Set Plane) =
94         convexHull ℝ ({frame x, frame y, frame z} : Set Plane) := by
95       change frame.toAffineMap '' _ = _
96       rw [frame.toAffineMap.image_convexHull]
97       simp only [image_insert_eq, image_singleton]
98       rfl
99     rw [triangle, triangle, at_root, at_upper, at_lower, on_ray L]
100   have upper_source : z + d • direction δ = y + D • direction (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) := by
101     apply frame.injective
102     rw [at_upper, next_formula, add_sub_cancel_left, map_smul, directions, add_sub_cancel_right]
103     ext i
104     fin_cases i
105     · change 0 = D * cos Θ + (r + L)
106       linarith [N.source_x]
107     · change d * sin ((δ - γ) / 2) = D * sin Θ + 0
108       linarith [N.source_y]
109   have lower_source : z + d • direction γ = y + D • direction (2 * π - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) := by
110     apply frame.injective
111     rw [at_lower, next_formula, add_sub_cancel_left, map_smul, directions, add_sub_cancel_right,
112       direction_two_pi_sub]
113     ext i
114     fin_cases i
115     · change 0 = D * cos (-Θ) + (r + L)
116       rw [cos_neg]
117       linarith [N.source_x]
118     · change -(d * sin ((δ - γ) / 2)) = D * sin (-Θ) + 0
119       rw [sin_neg]
120       linarith [N.source_y]
121   refine ⟨D, Θ, N.radius_pos, N.angle_pos, N.angle_lt_pi, upper_source, lower_source, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
122   · intro x member
123     have image_member : frame x ∈ frame '' {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * π)} := by
124       rw [before_image]
125       apply step.1
126       rw [← old_image]
127       exact ⟨x, member, rfl⟩
128     obtain ⟨x', hx', same⟩ := image_member
129     exact frame.injective same ▸ hx'
130   · apply Disjoint.of_image (f := frame)
131     have interior_image : frame '' interior (gapKite z d L γ δ) =
132         interior (frame '' gapKite z d L γ δ) := frame.toHomeomorph.image_interior _
133     rw [before_image, interior_image, kite_image]
134     exact step.2.1
135   · apply Set.image_injective.mpr frame.injective
136     rw [after_image, image_union, before_image, kite_image]
137     exact step.2.2
138 
139 /-- The set-theoretic step, with the source-coordinate identities omitted. -/
140 theorem gap_rotate_and_move (z : Plane) {d L α β γ δ ω : ℝ}
141     (source_positive : 0 < d) (length_positive : 0 < L)
142     (gap_ordered : γ < δ) (gap_width : δ < γ + 2 * π)
143     (separated : (β ≤ γ ∧ δ ≤ α + 2 * π) ∨ (δ ≤ α ∧ β ≤ γ + 2 * π))
144     (outer_lower : π / 2 ≤ ω)
145     (budget : ω + angle z (z + d • direction δ) (z + L • direction ((γ + δ) / 2)) ≤ 3 * π / 2) :
146     let y := z + L • direction ((γ + δ) / 2)
147     let apex := angle z (z + d • direction δ) y
148     let W := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω α β}
149     let V := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * π)}
150     ∃ D Θ : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ 0 < Θ ∧ Θ < π ∧
151       let W' := {x | x - y ∈ polarRegion D (ω + apex)
152         (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) (2 * π - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)}
153       W ⊆ V ∧ Disjoint V (interior (gapKite z d L γ δ)) ∧ W' = V ∪ gapKite z d L γ δ := by
154   obtain ⟨D, Θ, dp, tp, ts, _, _, step⟩ := gap_rotate_and_move_with_sources z
155     source_positive length_positive gap_ordered gap_width separated outer_lower budget
156   exact ⟨D, Θ, dp, tp, ts, step⟩
157 
158 end SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
